title: Each backlog item records its provenance, and a clone with an upstream shows only its own items unless asked for all
goal: backlog.py new records in each item it writes the clone it was filed in; in a clone whose git config names kb.upstreamRemote an item that arrived from the upstream main is marked upstream; list, next, horizon and sprint planning show only the clone's own items unless --all is given; claim, set and done refuse an upstream item there; backlog.md says how provenance is read

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
B=os.path.abspath('_tools/backlog.py');t=tempfile.mkdtemp();u=os.path.join(t,'up');c=os.path.join(t,'team')
g=lambda d,*a:s.run(['git','-C',d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True)
b=lambda d,*a:s.run([sys.executable,B,'--root',d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True)
os.makedirs(u);g(u,'init','-q','-b','main');open(os.path.join(u,'backlog.json'),'w').write(json.dumps({'item_dir':'items'}))
b(u,'new','story','--title','upstream planted item');g(u,'add','-A');g(u,'-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@example.com','commit','-qm','up')
s.run(['git','clone','-q',u,c]);g(c,'remote','rename','origin','upstream');g(c,'config','kb.upstreamRemote','upstream');g(c,'config','kb.scope','team')
b(c,'new','story','--title','team planted item')
o=b(c,'list').stdout;a=b(c,'list','--all').stdout
ok='team planted item' in o and 'upstream planted item' not in o and 'upstream planted item' in a
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
